name: Felothar
aliases: the new khan of the Abzan
description: Felothar is an Abzan warrior who appears both as the Abzan khan leading the Council of Houses and as a rebel stripped of her place by Dromoka.

summary.text: Felothar is an Abzan warrior who appears both as the Abzan khan leading the Council of Houses and as a rebel stripped of her place by Dromoka.

bio.text: As Abzan khan, Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

bio.text: When Ajani reports that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons, she asks to hear more, then frees the three visitors and announces the evacuation and fortification of Arashin.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

bio.text: She leads the Abzan riders, with Ajani riding alongside her.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

bio.text: In Spirits of the Abzan, Dromoka has stripped her of her place and ordered her execution, and she leads the rebel charge on a mobile garrison, killing two honor guards who call her a traitor.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
"Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

bio.text: She pins the girl Vasi at sword point and swears to train her instead of killing her.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
"Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

bio.text: Vasi later summons two ancestor spirits and defeats Felothar but spares her.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

bio.text: Felothar gives Vasi the sword Heartsblood and heads back to the rebel encampment as the camp prepares to depart for battle against Dromoka's forces.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
"Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story, Felothar is alive and returning to the rebel encampment as it prepares to march to battle against Dromoka's forces.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: The performers change masks to portray the five rebellion leaders, each clan's hero.
timeline.quote: they were masked again, this time in the images of Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul, the Twice Whisperer

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Khan Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.
timeline.quote: We have all the time in the world.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts into the chamber to report that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Felothar asks to hear more and Ajani begins to tell his tale.
timeline.quote: And Ajani told his tale.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
timeline.quote: You three are free to go.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
timeline.quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani, riding with Felothar, sees Narset in danger and decides to leap from his dragon.
timeline.quote: he really could just choose to do something.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The rebels attack the mobile garrison at dusk, with Felothar leading the charge.
timeline.quote: The rebels fall upon the mobile garrison at dusk, sweeping in from the desert with the sun at their backs.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar defeats and spares an unarmed young man who yields.
timeline.quote: Terror in his eyes, the boy does so. She leaves him be.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar kills two honor guards outside a tent, after they call her a traitor.
timeline.quote: He's talented, well-trained, but injured and now alone. Felothar makes short work of him.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Inside the tent, Felothar finds the girl Vasi and duels her, and Felothar ends up pinning her at sword point.
timeline.quote: "Fair enough," the girl pants. "My name is Vasi."

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar offers to train Vasi instead of killing her, and they swear oaths: Felothar to train her, Vasi not to escape until they duel.
timeline.quote: "Instead, I'll make you an offer. I'll train you."

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: A month into Vasi's training, Felothar spars with her in the caverns, corners her and teaches a lesson about terrain.
timeline.quote: She pivots and knocks the blade from Vasi's hand, then puts the flat of her blade to the girl's neck.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi mentions her ward-sister, then angrily changes the subject.
timeline.quote: "My ward-sister always said the terrain makes the battle."

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: At the Kin-Tree Felothar explains why the ancestors matter and how Anafenza showed Dromoka's claim to be a lie.
timeline.quote: Anafenza proved that to be a lie when she discovered and bonded with one.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar reveals her chosen family and how the ancestors shaped her, and Vasi tells of her ward-sister Bara.
timeline.quote: But one, Bara, we were … like sisters.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi asks whether the rebels can truly stand against Dromoka, and Felothar admits she has doubts but will walk her path.
timeline.quote: "My path is set," Felothar says at last, "and I will walk it.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi confronts Felothar after learning she plans to lead an attack and refuses to tell her.
timeline.quote: "You swore to me!" Vasi's words echo through the cavern.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi leaves the camp while Felothar attends the war council.
timeline.quote: Only later does she realize what her apprentice was truly asking for, and by that time, Vasi is already gone.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar finds Vasi on a mountain path and they fight in the dark.
timeline.quote: "So did you," she says and lunges forward.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi summons two ancestor spirits from the sand and defeats Felothar, but spares her.
timeline.quote: the sand beside her shifts, coalescing into two figures clad in ancient Abzan armor, semi-transparent in the starlight.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi explains that she offered her blood to the Kin-Tree and was told where to find her ward-sister Bara.
timeline.quote: "Looking for Bara, my ward-sister," Vasi says.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar gives Vasi Heartsblood and Vasi goes with her spirit escort to find Bara.
timeline.quote: "Take Heartsblood," she says, "May it see you safely to your goals."

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar heads back to the rebel encampment as the camp prepares to depart for battle against Dromoka's forces.
timeline.quote: she does know that her family is stronger than Dromoka imagines.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar rebels against Dromoka after the invasion and is chosen as khan.
timeline.quote: was chosen after rebelling against Dromoka in the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Felothar's court, Ajani warns them that Sarkhan has become an enormous dragon controlling the wild dragons.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol had taken the form of an enormous dragon

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Stormplains temple, Narset, Elspeth and the Abzan fight Sarkhan's wild dragons; Ugin appears and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, though Bolas has escaped.
timeline.quote: Ugin appeared and immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
